owner_calls.title: X-Men '97
owner_calls.question: Is Bishop on the team that destroys Trask's Sentinels and Master Mold at the Sahara junkyard in X-Men '97#1? He is a full X-Men member there and in the episode's cast, but no source I could reach says he is in that fight.
options: Add enemy stage at X-Men '97#1: Bishop joins the X-Men in destroying Trask's reactivated Sentinels and Master Mold in the Sahara.
None: no confirmed exchange in X-Men '97 (his #3 fears of Sentinels are the Goblin Queen's illusions).
owner_calls.evidence: Wikipedia #1 plot: the X-Men destroy the remains of several Sentinels and a Master Mold in the Sahara and arrest Trask. Marvel Database lists Bishop among the featured X-Men in #1 and the Sentinels as destroyed, but doesn't say which members fight. In #3, the Sentinels are only an illusion.
